items.title: All the credit cards can be divided into 4 categories for forex transactions. 💳🌍 1️⃣ Category-1: Best Ones 🏆 The credit cards which refund the entire forex mark-up charges along with the main amount in case of order cancellation + they do not charge any mark-up on the refund amount. 👉 HDFC Credit Cards are Category-1 cards. Use HDFC Bank’s Infinia or Diners Black Credit Card after activating the Global Value Program, and get 3.33% Rewards + 1% Cashback - 2.36% Forex Mark-up = 1.97% Net Valueback. And most importantly, no risk of losing money in case of a refund. ✅ 2️⃣ Category-2: Not-so-good ⚠️ Cards like HSBC credit cards which do not refund forex mark-up charges, but they also do not charge anything on the refund amount. So, not the best, but better than Axis Bank and ICICI Bank Credit Cards. 👉 Use HSBC Premier Card, if you have one, as it charges just 1.17% Forex Mark-up, so you lose relatively small amount in case of a refund. Plus, you get 3% reward points, which is 6.6% Valueback if you are into Accor redemption. So, the Net Valueback is 5.43% in Accor value after adjusting the Forex Mark-up fee. 🏨✨ 👉Of course, our favourite HSBC Travel One Card beats everyone for forex transactions if its famous Zero Forex Mark-up offer is on. 🔥. You get 4% rewards = 8.8% Accor Value and no forex mark-up charges. 💯. Wait for 15th August for upcoming Zero forex mark-up offer on HSBC Cards. 3️⃣ Category-3: Zero Forex Mark-up Cards 💳✈️ Cards like Scapia, RBL World Safari, AU ixigo, IDFC WOW Credit Card etc. do not charge any mark-up on forex transactions. So, there is no issue of losing money in case of a refund. 👍 However, cards like Scapia do not offer any rewards on forex transactions. 4️⃣ Category-4: The Worst Cards ❌ The cards which do not refund Forex Mark-up charges in case of a refund AND charge forex mark-up on the refund amount also. So, double loss. 😬 👉Axis and ICICI Bank Credit Cards are the worst as they do not refund Forex Mark-up charges, and charge another forex mark-up on the refund. So, you lose around 8.26% amount on refund of forex transactions on mid and entry-level credit cards like Axis Atlas, ICICI Sapphiro etc. On super-premium cards like ICICI Emeralde Metal Private Card and Axis Magnus Card, you lose around 4.72% in case of a refund of a forex transaction. 👉 This is something you should definitely check before using your credit card for large forex transactions. 👇👇👇If you know about other credit cards, mention in comments which category they fall into.
